# US-listed shares bought with US dollars, in a transaction stated in Hong Kong
# dollars that values both at nothing.
#
# The shares take their cost from the dollars that paid, divided across what
# they bought by each split's value against the value of what paid. Valued at
# nothing, the dollars say nothing about how their 2,600.00 CAD divides, so the
# purchase is refused with that said, rather than ending the import on a
# division by zero.
#
# GnuCash takes a split valued at nothing, as
# `tests/fixtures/a_cost_basis_whose_split_is_valued_at_nothing.txt` shows.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_share_purchase_is_costed_from_what_the_dollars_cost_whatever_it_is_stated_in.py.
2033-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 commodity HKD
	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 commodity USD_TECH
	mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
	fullname: "A technology company whose shares are priced in US dollars"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2033-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:Tech Shares
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
2033-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2033-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 15000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -15000.00 CAD

2033-01-05 * "Buy 10,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 10000.00 USD
		guid: "f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f90001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "13000.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -13000.00 CAD

2033-01-08 * "Buy 50 USD_TECH for 2,000.00 USD, valued at nothing"
	currency.mnemonic: "HKD"
	Assets:Tech Shares 50.0000 USD_TECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
		share_price: "0"
		value: "0.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -2000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "0"
		value: "0.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f9f90001"
